framework.name: CERT-In Cyber Security Directions 2022 & CCMP
framework.description: Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) Cyber Security Directions for mandatory incident reporting, log retention, time synchronization, and Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) execution for enterprise IT, public sector, and BFSI operations.

controls.title: Mandatory 6-Hour Cyber Security Incident Reporting
controls.description: Any service provider, intermediary, data center, body corporate, and government organization must report cyber security incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of notice.
evidence_checklist: CERT-In Incident Escalation Workflow Policy Document
Designated Point of Contact (PoC) Details submitted to CERT-In
Incident Logging and SLA Audit Log (Within 6 hours)

controls.title: Designation of Cyber Security Point of Contact (PoC)
controls.description: Organizations must designate a specialized Point of Contact to communicate with CERT-In and provide technical evidence during cyber security incidents.
evidence_checklist: Designated CISO / Security Officer Appointment Letter
CERT-In Portal Registration and Communication History

controls.title: Mandatory 180-Day System & Security Log Retention
controls.description: All ICT systems, servers, firewalls, and application workloads must maintain immutable system logs for a rolling period of 180 days within the Indian jurisdiction.
evidence_checklist: Centralized Syslog / SIEM Server Configuration
Log Storage Volume Retention Settings (>= 180 Days)
Audit Log Integrity & Encryption Verification

controls.title: NTP Clock Synchronization with NPL / NIC Time Servers
controls.description: All ICT infrastructure clocks must synchronize time with standard National Physical Laboratory (NPL) or National Informatics Centre (NIC) NTP servers.
evidence_checklist: NTP Client Configuration File (/etc/ntp.conf or chrony.conf / w32tm)
NTP Synchronization Status Audit Log (samay.nplindia.in or nic.in)

controls.title: 5-Year VPN & IP Subscriber Record Retention
controls.description: Virtual Private Network (VPN) service providers and enterprise infrastructure must retain validated customer/subscriber logs and IP allocation history for 5 years.
evidence_checklist: VPN Gateway Access Log Retention Configuration (>= 5 Years)
User Identity / IP Address Allocation Audit Ledger

controls.title: ICT Asset Inventory & Subscriber KYC Validation
controls.description: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all network endpoints, cloud resources, servers, and validated subscriber/user identities.
evidence_checklist: Automated Asset Discovery Inventory Log
Identity & Access Management (IAM) User Database Audit

controls.title: Periodic ICT Vulnerability Assessments & Audits
controls.description: Conduct periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration testing (VAPT), and security posture audits by CERT-In empanelled auditors.
evidence_checklist: VAPT Audit Report from CERT-In Empannelled Auditor
Vulnerability Remediation Tracking Ledger
Scan History Audit Log (< 90 Days)

controls.title: Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) Execution
controls.description: Formulate, approve, and routinely drill a Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) addressing critical infrastructure cyber threats and recovery.
evidence_checklist: Board-Approved Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP) Document
Annual Cyber Drill & Simulation Minutes of Meeting

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for Administrative Access
controls.description: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across all administrative access points, root portals, remote desktop, and SSH bastion servers.
evidence_checklist: MFA Policy Enforcement Log on Bastion / Admin Portals
PAM (Privileged Access Management) Audit Log

controls.title: Data Encryption at Rest & In Transit
controls.description: Protect operational data, system backups, and sensitive communications using strong cryptographic protocols (TLS 1.2+, AES-256).
evidence_checklist: TLS Certificate Audit Log (No deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1)
Disk & Storage Encryption Status Report
